name: GPU Volume Slicing (Advanced/Transform)
definition: A GPU kernel that renders a 2D slice using an arbitrary 4x4 transformation matrix (`trans`) applied to screen coordinates, followed by scaling.
summary: GPU Volume Slicing (Advanced/Transform) renders 2D slices from 3D volumes by applying arbitrary 4x4 transformation matrices directly in the pixel shader, supporting complex spatial transformations unlike basic fixed-axis alignment.
